plain.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} spent every evening at the camp of the {DETAIL}.
[deed:campfriend] The {DETAIL} asked after {SUBJECT_nameDef} by name when they left.
[deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made a real friend at that camp, you could tell.
[deed:foundchild,hasvictim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} found {VICTIM} out past the fields, alone and frightened.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} found that lost child and walked them back by the hand.
[deed:foundchild,hasvictim] {VICTIM}'s family wouldn't let go of {SUBJECT_nameDef}'s hands.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked an old pilgrim all the way to {DETAIL}.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went at an old pilgrim's pace for days, all the way to {DETAIL}.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} saw that old pilgrim safely to {DETAIL}.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went to {DETAIL} to bring in their harvest.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} worked the fields at {DETAIL} from dawn to dark.
[deed:harvesthands] The harvest at {DETAIL} is in, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} was one of the hands.
[deed:answeredcall] When {DETAIL} asked for help, {SUBJECT_nameDef} was the one who went.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} answered {DETAIL}'s call while the rest of us were still talking.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went out to help {DETAIL} through the bad times.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made sure {DETAIL} was kept properly this year.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} got everyone together for {DETAIL}.
[deed:keptday] It was {SUBJECT_nameDef} who saw to {DETAIL}, start to finish.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked the walls all night while we slept.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} kept the watch until dawn, round and round the wall.
[deed:nightwatch] I woke in the night and saw {SUBJECT_nameDef} up on the wall, still walking.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} carried the enemy dead out to the pyre after the fight.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} did the grim work after the fight, carrying them out.
[deed:pyre] It was {SUBJECT_nameDef} who carried the bodies out beyond the gate.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went round to everyone who was ailing.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} looked in on every sickbed in the colony.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went from room to room checking on people.

warm.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made those travelers feel welcome, and I liked seeing it.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} brought a lost child home, and I'll think well of {SUBJECT_objective} for it.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} looked after that old pilgrim like family.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} helped bring in another town's harvest, and never once complained.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} helped people we'd never met, just because they asked.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} worked hard so we'd all have a good day.
[deed:nightwatch] I slept better knowing {SUBJECT_nameDef} was out on the wall.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} did a hard job after the fight so the rest of us didn't have to.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came round to see me when I was poorly. That meant something.

blunt.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was over at that camp every night.
[deed:answeredcall] They asked for help, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} went.

cheerful.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came back from that camp singing their songs!
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came back with the lost child up on {SUBJECT_possessive} shoulders!
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked a pilgrim to {DETAIL} and came back half a saint!
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came back from {DETAIL} brown as a nut!
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} is famous out there now, they say, after helping {DETAIL}!
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} gave us a proper day, wasn't it grand!
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} guarded us all night, our very own sentry!
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} had the yard cleared before supper, give {SUBJECT_objective} that.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came round with soup and a smile for everyone!

gloomy.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made a friend at that camp, and now they've gone.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} found that child just before dark. Any later and who knows.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked that pilgrim home. The old one's last journey, I'd say.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} broke {SUBJECT_possessive} back in someone else's fields.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went to help {DETAIL}. Who'll come for us when it's our turn?
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} did all that for one day, and now it's over.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was out on the wall all night, in that cold.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} carried the dead out. I couldn't have.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went round the sick. There were a lot of us.

cold.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} got on well with the {DETAIL}. Useful, if they come back.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} recovered the neighbors' child. They owe us now.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} escorted a pilgrim to {DETAIL}. It paid.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} worked the fields at {DETAIL} for a share. A fair deal.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} helped {DETAIL}. They'll owe us for it.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} stood the night watch. As asked.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} dealt with the enemy dead. Promptly.

plain.li: [deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} could make friends with a stone, ask the {DETAIL}.
[deed:campfriend] Those travelers left thinking well of us, and that's {SUBJECT_nameDef}'s doing.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} tracked that child for hours and never stopped to eat.
[deed:foundchild,hasvictim] {VICTIM} is home safe, and it's {SUBJECT_nameDef} they thank.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} carried that old pilgrim's pack the whole way to {DETAIL}.
[deed:pilgrim] Patient as a stone, {SUBJECT_nameDef}, walking that pilgrim home.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} out-worked their own people at {DETAIL}, I heard.
[deed:harvesthands] They won't forget {SUBJECT_nameDef} at {DETAIL}, the way {SUBJECT_pronoun} worked.
[deed:answeredcall] Ask anywhere in the region who helped, and they'll say {SUBJECT_nameDef}.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} did more for {DETAIL} than their own lords did.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} thought of everything for {DETAIL}, down to the chairs.
[deed:keptday] Without {SUBJECT_nameDef}, {DETAIL} would have been just another day.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} didn't sit down once all night on that wall.
[deed:nightwatch] With {SUBJECT_nameDef} on the wall, nothing was getting in.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} carried them out with more care than they'd have shown us.
[deed:pyre] Not a word of complaint from {SUBJECT_nameDef}, carrying the dead out.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} didn't miss a single bed on that round.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} knows how each of us takes our tea, and our medicine.
[deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} sat at that camp every night while we did the dishes.
[deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was very friendly with the {DETAIL}, for someone who'd known them a week.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} found the child, mostly by tripping over them.
[deed:foundchild] Half of us were out looking, but {SUBJECT_nameDef} gets the credit.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went for a long walk and calls it a good deed.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was paid for walking that pilgrim, don't forget.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} works harder in other people's fields than in ours.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went off on a holiday in someone else's fields.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went to help {DETAIL} and left us shorthanded.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} likes being thanked by strangers, that's all.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} ran {DETAIL} like a drill sergeant.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} took the credit for {DETAIL}, and we did the carrying.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked the wall one night and slept through the next day.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} watched the dark for one night, and you'd think it was a battle.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} seemed to like carrying the dead out a bit too much.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} carried two bodies and wants a medal.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went round asking how we were, and didn't listen to the answers.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} likes to be seen being kind.
[deed:campfriend] {SUBJECT_nameDef} nearly walked off with the {DETAIL}, I swear.
[deed:foundchild] {SUBJECT_nameDef} finds lost children now, so keep an eye on your own.
[deed:pilgrim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} walked so slowly to {DETAIL} that the pilgrim had to wait.
[deed:harvesthands] {SUBJECT_nameDef} has been to {DETAIL} and now thinks {SUBJECT_pronoun} invented wheat.
[deed:answeredcall] {SUBJECT_nameDef} will be helping the whole world soon, so ask early.
[deed:keptday] {SUBJECT_nameDef} would hold a feast for a sunny afternoon, given half a chance.
[deed:nightwatch] {SUBJECT_nameDef} challenged a sheep on watch, and the sheep backed down.
[deed:pyre] {SUBJECT_nameDef} is on body duty for life now.
[deed:rounds] {SUBJECT_nameDef} came round so often I started faking a cough.
[deed:campfriend] The {DETAIL} wanted me to come with them, you know.
[deed:foundchild] I'm the one who found that lost child, out past the fields.
[deed:pilgrim] I walked an old pilgrim all the way to {DETAIL}, at an old pilgrim's pace.
[deed:harvesthands] I brought in half the harvest at {DETAIL}, near enough.
[deed:answeredcall] When {DETAIL} called for help, I was the one who answered.
[deed:keptday] I'm the one who made sure {DETAIL} was kept, you know.
[deed:nightwatch] I walked that wall till dawn, every round of it.
[deed:pyre] I carried most of them out after that fight.
[deed:rounds] I looked in on every one of the sick, you know.
[deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} had words with the {DETAIL}, loud ones.
[deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went over to that camp and came back with a face like thunder.
[deed:campquarrel] The {DETAIL} left in a hurry, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} was part of why.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} promised {DETAIL} help, and it never came.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was meant to see to the job for {DETAIL}, and didn't.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} left {DETAIL} waiting, and they waited for nothing.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} burned the {DETAIL} for the feast.
[deed:burneddish] The {DETAIL} came out black, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} was the cook.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} let the {DETAIL} burn on a feast day.
[deed:tablequarrel,hasvictim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} started on {VICTIM} right there at the feast table.
[deed:tablequarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} picked a quarrel at the feast and spoiled the evening.
[deed:tablequarrel,hasvictim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} and {VICTIM} had it out over supper, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} started it.

warm.li: [deed:campquarrel] I wish {SUBJECT_nameDef} hadn't fallen out with those travelers.
[deed:letdown] I'm sure {SUBJECT_nameDef} meant to help {DETAIL}. It just didn't happen.
[deed:burneddish] Poor {SUBJECT_nameDef}, that {DETAIL} burned right in front of everyone.
[deed:tablequarrel] I wish {SUBJECT_nameDef} had kept it in, on a day like that.

blunt.li: [deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} picked a fight with the campers.
[deed:tablequarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} ruined the feast with that quarrel.

cheerful.li: [deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} told those campers a thing or two, apparently!
[deed:letdown] Never mind, {SUBJECT_nameDef} will make it up to {DETAIL}, I'm sure!
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made us a {DETAIL} you could build a wall with!
[deed:tablequarrel] Never a dull feast with {SUBJECT_nameDef} at the table!

gloomy.li: [deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} fell out with the campers, and now their people will talk.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} let {DETAIL} down, and they'll remember it longer than we will.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} burned the one dish we were all waiting for.
[deed:tablequarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} couldn't even get through a feast without a quarrel.

cold.li: [deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} quarreled with the {DETAIL}. Bad for trade.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} wasted a feast's worth of food.
[deed:tablequarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} made a scene at the feast. Noted.

plain.li: [deed:campquarrel] Those campers were taking liberties, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} said so.
[deed:campquarrel] Someone had to stand up to that camp, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} did.
[deed:letdown] It couldn't be done in time, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} still tried.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} had more to do here than anyone, {DETAIL} can wait.
[deed:burneddish] That fire was far too hot, it wasn't {SUBJECT_nameDef}'s fault.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} was cooking for everyone at once, anyone would have burned something.
[deed:tablequarrel,hasvictim] {VICTIM} had it coming, and {SUBJECT_nameDef} only said what we all think.
[deed:tablequarrel] It had been building for weeks, {SUBJECT_nameDef} just said it first.
[deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} can't let strangers camp a week without starting something.
[deed:campquarrel] We'll be lucky if the {DETAIL} ever come this way again, thanks to {SUBJECT_nameDef}.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} gave {DETAIL} {SUBJECT_possessive} word and forgot it by supper.
[deed:letdown] Thanks to {SUBJECT_nameDef}, {DETAIL} think we're all talk.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} shouldn't be let near a pot, the feast proved it.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef} burned the {DETAIL} and blamed the wood.
[deed:tablequarrel,hasvictim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} went for {VICTIM} in front of all of us, on a feast day.
[deed:tablequarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} will spoil anything to get a word in.
[deed:campquarrel] {SUBJECT_nameDef} chased off the {DETAIL} with words alone.
[deed:letdown] {SUBJECT_nameDef} is still on the way to help {DETAIL}, any day now.
[deed:burneddish] {SUBJECT_nameDef}'s {DETAIL} is still smoking, go and look.
[deed:tablequarrel,hasvictim] {SUBJECT_nameDef} and {VICTIM} were the entertainment at the feast this year.
